meta.name: antinet-provenance
meta.description: 软件开发工程师与信息安全分析师在构建多智能体系统时，当需全链路可观测与安全审计，请用此技能。它自动收集操作日志，生成可追溯证据链与向量索引，开箱即用实现系统审计与精准回放，让Agent运行安全透明。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 收集Agent操作日志，构建可溯源证据链，实现安全审计与精准回放。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在构建多智能体系统，需要全链路可观测与安全审计。
copy.tagline_en: Collect agent operation logs as evidence chains for audit and replay.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building multi-agent systems and need full observability and audit trails.

howto.what: 它会在分发、扫描、解析、卡片生成等关键节点记录操作事件，产出按 trace_id 串联的证据链、用于语义检索的向量索引，以及按条件检索历史证据的接口。
howto.when: 构建多智能体系统、需要全链路可观测或安全审计时接管；由各官署在关键操作节点调用，或经事件总线异步推送写入证据链。

say.text: 运行 provenance 阶段，把这些多智能体操作事件写入证据链
按 trace_id 检索这条链路的完整证据
按官署和时间窗查最近的审计记录
say.note: 检索超时会返回标注 stale 的快照

howto.what_en: It records operation events at dispatch, scan, parse and card-generation nodes, then outputs a trace_id-linked evidence chain, a vector index for semantic search, and an API to query past evidence.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you build multi-agent systems needing end-to-end observability or security audit; offices call it at key operation nodes or push events asynchronously via the event bus.

say_en.text: Run the provenance stage to write these multi-agent events into the evidence chain
Retrieve the full evidence chain by trace_id
Query recent audit records by office and time window
say_en.note: Timeout returns a snapshot marked stale
